⬡  GRC Decorative Systems

أنظمة GRC الزخرفية

The art of architectural ornament, perfected

Glass Reinforced Concrete (GRC) is the material of palace architecture — lightweight yet monumental, detailed yet durable. Our GRC collection includes over 500 decorative elements, all customizable to your project.

Request This Service
What's Included
  • Corinthian & Ionic columns
  • Custom capital designs
  • Cornices & entablatures
  • Window & door surrounds
  • Balustrades & railings
  • Domes & cupolas
03

✦  Facade Transformations

تحويل الواجهات

From ordinary to iconic — in one complete renovation

Our transformation service takes existing buildings and elevates them to luxury landmarks. Using GRC cladding, new architectural layering, and complete replanning of the facade language, we create dramatic before-and-after results.

Request This Service
What's Included
  • Complete facade assessment
  • Structural compatibility analysis
  • Layer-by-layer transformation plan
  • GRC cladding installation
  • Full project management
  • Photographic documentation

How We Work

Our Design Process

عملية التصميم لدينا

01

Discovery

الاستكشاف

We begin with a detailed consultation to understand your vision, property, preferences, and budget. No judgement — only possibility.

02

Design

التصميم

Our team develops multiple facade concepts using AI-assisted exploration and classical architectural drawing, refined to your input.

03

Visualization

التصور

Photorealistic renders and 360° walkthroughs bring your chosen design to life. You approve every element before fabrication.

04

Delivery

التسليم

We manage fabrication, logistics, and installation with a dedicated project team, delivering on schedule and to specification.
